name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Record $6.3bn Binance theft blamed on North Korea; Belgian tax portal and Moldovan sites hit
state: The FBI said on 1 Nov that North Korea stole more than $6bn from Binance in late October, the largest crypto theft on record. Belgium took its tax portal offline after an attack on 28 Oct, and more than 80 Moldovan public service websites were knocked out. A 26 Oct attack forced ambulance diversions at University of New Mexico hospitals. No national-scale outage of power or health systems was reported as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Be alert to phishing linked to data-breach news; NCSC guidance covers how to protect accounts.
rubric_hit: Attacks disrupting a major exchange and government services = Watch; theft, not destructive
